καγω.def: I also, I too, but I.

καθαιρεω.def: (a) I take down, pull down, depose, destroy.

καθαπτω.gloss: I lay hold of, fasten on to
καθαπτω.def: I lay hold of, fasten on to, seize, attack.

καθαριζω.def: I cleanse, make clean, literally, ceremonially, or spiritually, according to context.

καθαρισμοσ.def: cleansing, purifying, purification, literal, ceremonial, or moral; met: expiation.

καθαροσ.def: clean, pure, unstained, either literally or ceremonially or spiritually; guiltless, innocent, upright.

καθεζομαι.gloss: I am sitting, sit, am seated
καθεζομαι.def: I am sitting, sit down, am seated.

καθεξησ.def: in order, in succession, in the time immediately after, just after.

καθηκω.def: I come down, come to; I am unfit, proper.

καθημαι.def: I sit, am seated, enthroned; I dwell, reside.

καθιζω.def: (a) trans: I make to sit; I set, appoint, (b) intrans: I sit down, am seated, stay.

καθιστημι.def: I set down, bring down to a place; I set in order, appoint, make, constitute.

καθο.def: according to which thing, as, according as.

καθολου.def: one the whole, in general, altogether.

καθοτι.def: (a) in proportion as, according as, (b) because.

καθωσ.def: according to the manner in which, in the degree that, just as, as.

καιν.def: (Hebrew), Cain, son of Adam and Eve and brother of Abel.

καιναν.def: (Hebrew), Cainan, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

καιροσ.def: fitting season, season, opportunity, occasion, time.

καισαρ.def: Caesar, a surname of the gens Iulia, which became practically synonymous with the Emperor for the time being; in the Gospels it always refers to Tiberias.

καισαρεια.def: Two cities of Palestine: one in Galilee (Caesarea Philippi), the other on the coast of the Mediterranean.

καιω.def: I ignite, light, burn, lit. and met; I consume with fire.

κακει.def: and there, and yonder, there also.

κακειθεν.def: and thence, and from there; and then afterwards.

κακεινοσ.gloss: and he, she, it, and that
κακεινοσ.def: and he, she, it, and that.

κακια.def: (a) evil (i.e. trouble, labor, misfortune), (b) wickedness, (c) vicious disposition, malice, spite.

κακολογεω.def: I speak evil of, curse, revile, abuse.

κακοπαθεια.def: experience of evil, suffering, distress, affliction, perseverance.

κακοποιεω.def: I do harm, do wrong, do evil, commit sin.

κακοσ.def: bad, evil, in the widest sense.

κακοω.def: I treat badly, afflict, embitter, make angry.

καλαμοσ.def: a reed; a reed-pen, reed-staff, measuring rod.

καλεω.def: (a) I call, summon, invite, (b) I call, name.

καλοδιδασκαλοσ.gloss: a teacher of that which is noble
καλοδιδασκαλοσ.def: a teacher of that which is noble (honorable) and good.

καλοποιεω.def: I do well, act honorably, do what is right.

καλοσ.def: beautiful, as an outward sign of the inward good, noble, honorable character; good, worthy, honorable, noble, and seen to be so.

καλυμμα.def: a covering, especially a covering of head and face, a veil.

καμνω.def: I work, am weary, am sick.

καν.def: and if, even if, even, at least.

κανδακη.def: Candace, a proper name; the Candace, a dynastic name for queens of the Ethiopians in Abyssinia.

κανων.def: (lit: a level, ruler), a rule, regulation, rule of conduct or doctrine, (b) a measured (defined) area, province.

καπηλευω.def: I hawk, trade in, deal in for purposes of gain.

καππαδοκια.def: Cappadocia, a large Roman province in the central eastern part of Asia Minor.

καρδια.def: lit: the heart; mind, character, inner self, will, intention, center.

καρδιογνωστησ.gloss: a knower of the inner life
καρδιογνωστησ.def: a knower of the inner life (character, hearts).

καρποσ.def: (a) fruit, generally vegetable, sometimes animal, (b) met: fruit, deed, action, result, (c) profit, gain.

καρτερεω.def: I persevere, endure, am steadfast, patient.

καρφοσ.gloss: a dry stalk, chip of wood
καρφοσ.def: a dry stalk, chip of wood, twig, splinter, chaff.

κατα.gloss: down from, against, according to, throughout, during
κατα.def: gen: against, down from, throughout, by; acc: over against, among, daily, day-by-day, each day, according to, by way of.

καταβαινω.def: I go down, come down, either from the sky or from higher land, descend.

καταβαλλω.def: (a) mid: I lay, of a foundation, (b) met: I cast down, prostrate.

καταβιβαζω.gloss: I bring down, cause to go down
καταβιβαζω.def: I bring down, cast down, cause to go down.

καταβολη.def: (a) foundation, (b) depositing, sowing, deposit, technically used of the act of conception.

καταβραβευω.def: of the umpire in a contest: I decide against, take part against, condemn (perhaps with the idea of assumption, officialism).

καταγγελλω.def: I declare openly, proclaim, preach, laud, celebrate.

καταγνυμι.def: I break down (in pieces), crush, break into.

καταγω.def: I lead down, bring down, either from a high place on land or to a lower (or actually to the sea-coast), or from the high seas to land.

καταγωνιζομαι.def: I subdue (in warfare); I struggle against, conquer, overcome.

καταισχυνω.gloss: I shame, disgrace, put to utter confusion
καταισχυνω.def: I shame, disgrace, bring to shame, put to utter confusion, frustrate.

κατακειμαι.def: I recline (at table); more often: I keep my bed, am lying ill (in bed).

κατακλαω.def: I break in pieces, break up.

κατακληρονομεω.def: I give as an inheritance, distribute by lot.

κατακλινω.def: I cause to recline at table; mid. and pass: I recline at table.

κατακοπτω.def: I cut up, cut in pieces, mangle, wound.

κατακρημνιζω.def: I cast down headlong, throw over a precipice.

κατακριμα.def: punishment following condemnation, penal servitude, penalty.

κατακρινω.def: I condemn, judge worthy of punishment.

κατακυριευω.def: I exercise authority over, overpower, master.

καταλαλεω.def: I speak evil of, rail at, slander.

καταλαλοσ.def: slanderous, back-biting; subst: a railer, defamer.

καταλαμβανω.gloss: I seize tight hold of, overtake, comprehend
καταλαμβανω.def: (a) I seize tight hold of, arrest, catch, capture, appropriate, (b) I overtake, (c) mid. aor: I perceived, comprehended.

καταλεγω.gloss: I enter in a list, register
καταλεγω.def: I enter in a list, register, enroll.

καταλειπω.def: I leave behind, desert, abandon, forsake; I leave remaining, reserve.

καταλιθαζω.gloss: I stone down, stone to death
καταλιθαζω.def: I stone down, stone to death, overwhelm with stones.

καταλοιποσ.def: left behind; the rest, the remainder.

καταλυω.gloss: I break up, overthrow, unharness, find a lodging
καταλυω.def: (lit: I loosen thoroughly), (a) trans: I break up, overthrow, destroy, both lit. and met., (b) I unyoke, unharness a carriage horse or pack animal; hence: I put up, lodge, find a lodging.

καταμανθανω.def: I understand, take in a fact about, consider carefully.

καταμενω.def: I wait, stay (with), remain, abide, dwell.

καταναλισκω.def: I use up, spend, consume (as with fire).

καταναρκαω.def: (properly a medical term: I stupefy, hence) I burden, encumber.

κατανευω.def: I nod, make a sign, beckon.

κατανοεω.def: I take note of, perceive, consider carefully, discern, detect, make account of.

κατανταω.gloss: I come down, arrive at, reach
κατανταω.def: (a) I come down, either from high land to lower (or actually to the sea-coast), or from the high seas to the coast; hence met: I arrive at, reach (my destination), (b) of property: I come down (descend) by inheritance to an heir.

κατανυσσομαι.def: met: I am pierced, stung, smitten.

καταπατεω.def: I trample down, trample under foot (lit. and met.), spurn.

καταπαυσισ.def: (in the Old Testament of the rest attained by the settlement in Canaan), resting, rest, dwelling, habitation.

καταπαυω.def: (a) trans: I cause to rest, bring to rest; I cause to refrain, (b) intrans: I rest.

καταπετασμα.def: (lit: that which is spread out downwards, that which hangs down), a curtain, veil, of that which separated the Holy of Holies from the outer parts of the temple at Jerusalem, also of an outer curtain at the entrance to the Holy Place in the same temple.

καταπινω.def: I drink down, swallow, devour, destroy, consume.

καταπλεω.def: I sail down (from the high seas to the shore).

καταπονεω.def: I exhaust by labor or suffering, wear out, overpower, oppress.

καταποντιζω.gloss: I sink in the sea, am drowned
καταποντιζω.def: I sink in the sea, pass: I drown, am submerged.

καταρα.def: cursing; a curse; meton: a doomed one.

καταργεω.gloss: I bring to naught, sever, abolish
καταργεω.def: (a) I make idle (inactive), make of no effect, annul, abolish, bring to naught, (b) I discharge, sever, separate from.

καταρτιζω.def: (a) I fit (join) together; met: I compact together, (b) act. and mid: I prepare, perfect, for his (its) full destination or use, bring into its proper condition (whether for the first time, or after a lapse).

καταρτισμοσ.def: a bringing to a condition of fitness, perfecting.

κατασειω.def: I shake (the hand) up and down, wave; intrans: I beckon for silence.

κατασκαπτω.def: I dig down under, demolish, undermine.

κατασκευαζω.def: I build, construct, prepare, make ready.

κατασκηνοω.def: I encamp, take up my quarters, tabernacle, pitch my tent, dwell.

κατασκοπεω.def: I view closely, inspect, spy out.

καταστελλω.def: I let down, lower; I keep down, restrain, pacify.

καταστρωννυμι.def: I strew or spread over; I lay low, overthrow.

κατασφραγιζω.def: I seal up, secure with a seal.

κατατιθημι.def: (a) I lay down, deposit, (b) mid: I lay down or deposit a favor, with the view of receiving one in return, seek favor.

καταφερω.def: I bear down, overpower; I give a vote or verdict, bring charges.

καταφευγω.def: I flee for refuge (implying that the refuge is reached); aor. indicates moment of arrival.

καταφρονεω.def: I despise, scorn, and show it by active insult, disregard.

καταχραομαι.def: I use to the full, use up.

κατειδωλοσ.def: full of images of idols, grossly idolatrous.

κατενωπιον.def: before the face of, over against.

κατεργαζομαι.def: I effect by labor, achieve, work out, bring about.

κατερχομαι.def: I come down from sky to earth, or from high land to lower land (or to the coast), or from the high seas to the shore.

κατεσθιω.gloss: I eat till it is finished
κατεσθιω.def: I eat up, eat till it is finished, devour, squander, annoy, injure.

κατευθυνω.def: (a) I make straight, (b) met: I put in the right way, direct.

κατεφιστημι.def: I rush, assault, rise up against.

κατεχω.def: (a) I hold fast, bind, arrest, (b) I take possession of, lay hold of, (c) I hold back, detain, restrain, (d) I hold a ship, keep its head.

κατηφεια.def: a downcast countenance as a sign of sorrow, gloominess, gloom, dejection.

κατιοω.def: I rust; pass: I am rusted, tarnished.

κατισχυω.gloss: I prevail against, overpower, am able
κατισχυω.def: I prevail against, overpower, get the upper hand.

κατοικεω.gloss: I dwell in, settle in, inhabit
κατοικεω.def: I dwell in, settle in, am established in (permanently), inhabit.

κατορθωμα.def: anything happily and successfully accomplished, a beneficial and worthy deed.

κατω.def: (a) down, below, also: downwards, (b) lower, under, less, of a length of time.

καυτηριαζω.def: I cauterize, burn with a hot iron; hence met: I sear.

καυχημα.def: a boasting; a ground of boasting (glorying, exultation).

καυχησισ.def: the act of boasting, glorying, exultation.

κεγχρεαι.def: Cenchreae, the port of Corinth on the Saronic Gulf.

κειμαι.def: I lie, recline, am placed, am laid, set, specially appointed, destined.

κειρια.def: a kind of girdle made of cords; a bandage, grave clothes.

κειρω.gloss: I shear, cut the hair of
κειρω.def: I shear, cut the hair of; mid: I cut my own hair, have my hair cut.

κελευσμα.gloss: a word of command, a call
κελευσμα.def: a word of command, a call, an arousing outcry.

κενοσ.def: (a) empty, (b) met: empty (in moral content), vain, ineffective, foolish, worthless, (c) false, unreal, pretentious, hollow.

κενοω.gloss: I empty, deprive of content, make unreal
κενοω.def: (a) I empty, (b) I deprive of content, make unreal.

κεντρον.def: a sting, goad; met: of death.

κεντυριων.def: a centurion, an officer commanding about a hundred infantry in the Roman army.

κενωσ.def: falsely, in vain, to no purpose.

κεραια.def: a little hook, an apostrophe on letters of the alphabet, distinguishing them from other little letters, or a separation stroke between letters.

κεραμικοσ.gloss: of clay, made by a potter
κεραμικοσ.def: of clay, made by a potter, earthen.

κεραννυμι.gloss: I mix, pour out for drinking
κεραννυμι.def: I mix, mingle, pour out for drinking.

κερασ.def: (a) a horn, (b) a horn-like projection at the corner of an altar, (c) a horn as a symbol of power.

κερδαινω.def: I gain, acquire, win (over), avoid loss.

κερμα.def: a small coin; plur: small change.

κερματιστησ.def: properly: a changer of large into smaller coins, a money-changer.

κεφαλαιον.gloss: the chief matter, a sum of money
κεφαλαιον.def: (a) the chief matter, the main point, (b) a sum of money.

κεφαλη.def: (a) the head, (b) met: a corner stone, uniting two walls; head, ruler, lord.

κεφαλισ.def: (lit: little head, then: the knob at the end of the wooden core of a roll of papyrus, then) a roll, volume, division (of a book).

κηποσ.def: a garden, any place planted with trees and herbs.

κητοσ.def: a sea monster, huge sea fish, whale.

κηφασ.def: Cephas (Aramaic for rock), the new name given to Simon Peter, the apostle.

κιβωτοσ.def: (properly: a wooden box, hence) the Ark, in which Noah sailed; the Ark of the Covenant.

κιθαριζω.def: intrans. and trans: I play on the harp, I harp, with acc. of the tune.

κιθαρωδοσ.def: a harpist, one who sings with harp as accompaniment.

κιλικια.def: Cilicia, a Roman province between the Taurus range of mountains and the coast in the south-east corner of Asia Minor, linked up with the province of Syria.

κινδυνευω.def: I am in danger or peril.

κινεω.def: I set in motion, move, remove, excite, stir up.

κλαδοσ.def: a young tender shoot, then: a branch; met: of descendants.

κλαιω.def: I weep, weep for, mourn, lament.

κλαυδη.def: Cauda, Clauda, an island twenty-three miles south of the western end of Crete.

κλαυδια.def: Claudia, a Christian woman in Rome; probably a freedwoman of the imperial household.

κλαυδιοσ.def: (a) Claudius, the fourth of the Roman Emperors, Tiberius Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, who ruled A.D. 41-54, (b) Claudius Lysias, a tribune at Jerusalem.

κλεοπασ.def: Cleopas, one of the two companions of the risen Jesus from Jerusalem to Emmaus.

κλεοσ.def: glory, fame, praise; rumor, report, credit.

κλημησ.def: Clement, a fellow-worker of Paul in Rome.

κληρονομεω.def: I inherit, obtain (possess) by inheritance, acquire.

κληρονομια.def: an inheritance, an heritage, regularly the gift of God to His chosen people, in the Old Testament: the Promised Land, in NT a possession viewed in one sense as present, in another as future; a share, participation.

κληροσ.def: (a) a lot, (b) a portion assigned; hence: a portion of the people of God assigned to one's care, a congregation.

κληροω.def: I cast lots, choose by lot, assign by lot, assign a portion, receive a share.

κλησισ.def: a calling, invitation; in the NT, always of a divine call.

κλητοσ.def: called, invited, summoned by God to an office or to salvation.

κλιμα.def: a small geographical division, district, or territory.

κλινη.def: a couch, bed, portable bed or mat, a couch for reclining at meals, possibly also a bier.

κλινιδιον.def: a couch or litter of a sick person.

κλινω.gloss: I rest, recline, make to yield
κλινω.def: trans: I rest, recline; I bend, incline; I cause to give ground, make to yield; intrans: I decline, approach my end.

κλισια.gloss: a dining couch, group of diners
κλισια.def: properly: a dining couch; hence: a group of diners.

κλυδων.def: rough water, a wave, billow, surge.

κλυδωνιζομαι.def: I am tossed by waves, met: I am tossed to and fro.

κλωπασ.def: Clopas, husband of one Mary, who stood by the cross.

κνηθω.def: I rub, tickle, scratch; pass: I itch.

κνιδοσ.def: Cnidus, a town on the coast of Caria (south-west Asia Minor) near the island of Cos.

κοδραντησ.def: a "quadrans," the smallest Roman copper coin, a quarter of an "as," the sixteenth part of a "sesterius".

κοιλια.def: belly, abdomen, heart, a general term covering any organ in the abdomen, e.g. stomach, womb; met: the inner man.

κοιμαομαι.def: I fall asleep, am asleep, sometimes of the sleep of death.

κοινοσ.def: (a) common, shared, (b) Hebraistic use: profane; dirty, unclean, unwashed.

κοινοω.gloss: I make unclean, regard as unclean
κοινοω.def: I make unclean, pollute, desecrate, mid: I regard (treat) as unclean.

κοινωνεω.gloss: I share, communicate, have fellowship with
κοινωνεω.def: (a) I share, communicate, contribute, impart, (b) I share in, have a share of, have fellowship with.

κοινωνια.def: (lit: partnership) (a) contributory help, participation, (b) sharing in, communion, (c) spiritual fellowship, a fellowship in the spirit.

κοινωνικοσ.def: willing to share, sociable, ready to communicate, beneficent.

κοιτη.def: (a) a bed, (b) a marriage bed; plur: repeated (immoral) sexual intercourse.

κοκκινοσ.def: crimson, scarlet, dyed with Kermes (coccum), the female coccus of the Kermes oak.

κολαζω.def: I chastise, curtail, punish; mid: I cause to be punished.

κολακεια.def: flattery, with a view to advantage or gain.

κολασισ.def: chastisement, punishment, torment, perhaps with the idea of deprivation.

κολαφιζω.gloss: I strike with the fist, maltreat
κολαφιζω.def: I strike with the fist, buffet; hence: I mistreat violently.

κολλαω.gloss: I glue, cleave, keep company with
κολλαω.def: (lit: I glue); hence: mid. and pass: I join myself closely, cleave, adhere (to), I keep company (with), of friendly intercourse.

κολλυβιστησ.def: a money-changer, who changed heathen into Jewish money, for payment into the Temple treasury.

κολοβοω.def: (lit: I maim, mutilate), I cut short, shorten, abbreviate.

κολοσσαι.def: Colossae, a town of the Roman province Asia, in the Lycus valley, near Laodicea and Hierapolis.

κολποσ.gloss: bosom, bosom of a garment, a bay, gulf
κολποσ.def: (a) sing. and plur: bosom; (sinus) the overhanging fold of the garment used as a pocket, (b) a bay, gulf.

κολυμβηθρα.def: (lit: a diving or swimming place), a pool.

κολωνια.def: a colony, a city settlement of Roman (soldier) citizens; a garrison city.

κομαω.def: I wear the hair long, allow the hair to grow out.

κομιζω.def: (a) act: I convey, bring, carry, (b) mid: I receive back, receive what has belonged to myself but has been lost, or else promised but kept back, or: I get what has come to be my own by earning, recover.

κοπαζω.def: I abate, cease raging, am stilled.

κοπετοσ.def: beating of the breast or head in lamentation, lamentation.

κοπιαω.def: (a) I grow weary, (b) I toil, work with effort (of bodily and mental labor alike).

κοποσ.def: (a) trouble, (b) toil, labor, laborious toil, involving weariness and fatigue.

κοπτω.def: (a) I cut, cut off, strike, smite, (b) mid: I beat my breast or head in lamentation, lament, mourn, sometimes with acc. of person whose loss is mourned.

κορασιον.def: a little girl, a young girl; a girl, maiden.

κορβαν.def: a gift, offering, anything consecrated to God.

κορεννυμι.def: I fill, sate, glut, feed full, satisfy.

κορινθοσ.def: Corinth, in north-east Peloponnese, the capital of the Roman province Achaia.

κορνηλιοσ.def: Cornelius, a centurion of the Roman army, stationed at Caesarea.

κοσμεω.def: I put into order; I decorate, deck, adorn.

κοσμικοσ.def: earthly, worldly (belonging to the present earthly world as opposed to the heavenly and future).

κοσμοκρατωρ.def: ruler of this world, that is, of the world as asserting its independence of God; used of the angelic or demonic powers controlling the sublunary world.

κοσμοσ.def: the world, universe; worldly affairs; the inhabitants of the world; adornment.

κουαρτοσ.def: Quartus, a Christian, brother of Erastus the Corinthian.

κραβαττοσ.def: a bed, mattress, mat of a poor man.

κραταιοω.def: I strengthen, confirm; pass: I grow strong, become strong.

κρατεω.def: I am strong, mighty, hence: I rule, am master, prevail; I obtain, take hold of; I hold, hold fast.

κρατιστοσ.def: most excellent, an official epithet, used in addressing a Roman of high rank, and in the second century one of equestrian (as distinguished from senatorial) rank.

κρατοσ.def: dominion, strength, power; a mighty deed.

κραυγη.def: (a) a shout, cry, clamor, (b) outcry, clamoring against another.

κρεασ.def: flesh; plur: pieces of flesh, kinds of flesh.

κρεμαννυμι.def: I hang, hang up, suspend; mid: I am hanging, hang.

κρησ.def: a Cretan, an inhabitant of Crete.

κρησκησ.def: Crescens, a Christian, coadjutor of Paul.

κριμα.def: (a) a judgment, a verdict; sometimes implying an adverse verdict, a condemnation, (b) a case at law, a lawsuit.

κρινον.def: a lily growing wild, variously identified with the red anemone, the whole lily, the sword lily.

κρινω.def: (a) I judge, whether in a law-court or privately: sometimes with cognate nouns emphasizing the notion of the verb, (b) I decide, I think (it) good.

κρισισ.def: judging, judgment, decision, sentence; generally: divine judgment; accusation.

κρισποσ.def: Crispus, ruler of the synagogue at Corinth, converted and baptized by Paul.

κριτηριον.def: criterion; a law-court; a law-case before an arbiter; a cause, controversy.

κριτικοσ.def: critical, able to judge or discern.

κρουω.def: I knock, beat a door with a stick, to gain admittance.

κρυπτη.def: a cellar, vault, hidden place, crypt.

κρυπτοσ.def: hidden, secret; as subst: the hidden (secret) things (parts), the inward nature (character).

κρυσταλλιζω.def: I am clear as crystal, brilliant like crystal.

κταομαι.def: (a) I acquire, win, get, purchase, buy, (b) I possess, win mastery over.

κτημα.def: a piece of landed property, a field; plur: possessions, property, possibly landed property, property in land.

κτηνοσ.def: a beast of burden (generally, a horse or mule) either for riding or for carrying loads on its back, or for yoking to a cart or carriage.

κτιζω.def: I create, form, shape, make, always of God.

κτισισ.def: (often of the founding of a city), (a) abstr: creation, (b) concr: creation, creature, institution; always of Divine work, (c) an institution, ordinance.

κτιστησ.def: (often of the founder of a city), creator, God.

κυβεια.def: (lit: playing with dice, gaming, hence) trickery, sleight.

κυβερνητησ.def: a steersman, pilot; met: a guide, governor.

κυκλοθεν.def: in a circle round, round about.

κυλλοσ.def: crippled, lame, especially in the hands.

κυμινον.def: cumin, a plant used as a spice.

κυναριον.def: a little dog, a house dog.

κυπτω.def: I bend, stoop down, bow the head.

κυρηνη.def: Cyrene, a district west of Egypt on the Mediterranean coast, forming with Crete a Roman province.

κυρηνιοσ.def: Cyrenius or Quirinius, governor of Syria.

κυριακοσ.def: of the Lord, special to the Lord.

κυριοτησ.def: (a) abstr: lordship, (b) concr: divine or angelic lordship, domination, dignity, usually with reference to a celestial hierarchy.

κυροω.def: I ratify, confirm, make valid, reaffirm, assure.

κυων.def: a dog, universally despised in the East.

κωλον.def: a limb, member of a body; fig: a corpse, carcass.

κωλυω.def: I prevent, debar, hinder; with infin: from doing so and so.

κωμοπολισ.def: a large village, a city which in constitution has only the status of a village; a country town.

κωνωψ.def: a gnat, mosquito, referred to proverbially as something small.

κωσ.def: Cos, an island in the Aegean Sea, south-west of Asia Minor.

κωσαμ.def: Cosam, son of Elmadam and father of Addi.
